metadata.centroid_source: Curated manually for demo sorting only. Coordinates were not derived from or copied from an official/open locality dataset.
metadata.calculation_method: Estimated straight-line distance from curated suburb/locality centroid to warehouse via Haversine.
metadata.limitations: Static suburb-level estimated straight-line distance only; not driving distance, ETA, or route optimization.
